name: nc/post-title
title: Post title
description: Title of the current post or page, from h1 to p. Dynamic: read on every request.
aiHints: Use it in single layouts. Only one level 1 title per page. With settings.link the title is a link that inherits color and textDecoration of the title (no underline unless you set it); style group link: linkColor, linkColorHover, linkDecoration, linkDecorationHover (none, underline, inherit; hover defaults to underline). Its link part is styled with style.parts, for example style.parts.link.fontWeight 600.
